headline: Shri Krishna Devcon AGM approves FY26 financials
summary: Shri Krishna Devcon Ltd held its 32nd AGM on September 29, 2026, approving FY26 standalone and consolidated financials. Key resolutions included director re-appointments and material related party transactions.

headline: Calsoft concludes 34th AGM; reappoints key directors
summary: California Software Company Limited held its 34th AGM on September 29, 2026, via VC/OAVM. Members approved financial statements and reappointed Frederick Ivor Bendle and Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah.

headline: Niyogin Fintech sets Oct 30 meetings for scheme
summary: Niyogin Fintech Limited scheduled shareholder and creditor meetings on October 30, 2026, for the composite scheme of arrangement with Niyogin Finserv and iServeU.

headline: Agarwal Toughened Glass wins Rs 2.55 cr order from Relaxo
summary: Agarwal Toughened Glass secures Rs 2.55 crore work order from Relaxo Footwears for DGU glass supply. Order book coverage stands at ~0.0 quarters due to data gaps, with promoter holding dropping to 60.39%.

headline: Yuranus Infrastructure AGM: ₹0.10 dividend, new auditors
summary: Yuranus Infrastructure Limited held its 32nd AGM on September 29, 2026. Shareholders approved a final dividend of ₹0.10 per share and appointed DTA & Associates as statutory auditors.

headline: Jayesh Logistics wins Rs 26.88 Cr transport order from SAIL
summary: Jayesh Logistics secures a Rs 26.88 crore road transportation contract from SAIL for 2 years. This order significantly boosts the backlog, with book-to-bill metrics indicating strong future revenue visibility relative to current scale.

headline: Cps Shapers secures Rs 18,900 order from Kontri
summary: Cps Shapers has received an order worth Rs 18,900 from Kontri Sp. z o.o. for manufacturing and supply of bras. Delivery is scheduled by December 2026.

headline: Prime Cable Industries wins Rs 16.49 crore MV cable order
summary: Prime Cable Industries disclosed a Rs 16.49 crore order for 11 KV MV cables from a reputed Indian listed company, adding to its recent significant order inflows.

headline: Balaji Telefilms holds 32nd AGM; addresses compliance gaps
summary: Balaji Telefilms held its 32nd AGM via VC. The company addressed regulatory non-compliances regarding board composition and delayed financial results due to NCLT scheme pendency.

headline: Clara Industries holds 5th AGM, approves auditor reappointment
summary: Clara Industries Limited held its 5th Annual General Meeting for FY26 on September 29, 2026. The meeting approved the re-appointment of statutory auditors and several director appointments.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Arisinfra, NLC India, KSB in focus
summary: Order wins drive construction and power stocks. Arisinfra rallies on ₹400 crore deal, while NLC India expands capacity. Check key movers here.

headline: Smartworks secures ₹305 crore in new office deals
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Ltd announced new managed office deals worth ~₹305 crore from new clients, bringing total incremental revenue to ~₹540 crore.

headline: Computer Point AGM concludes with all resolutions passed
summary: Computer Point Limited held its 41st AGM on September 29, 2026. All four resolutions, including director appointments and financial adoption, were passed with overwhelming shareholder support.

headline: HEG Advanced Materials subsidiary Replus signs MoU with Indus Towers
summary: Replus Engitech, a subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials, signed an MoU with Indus Towers to explore Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions for telecom infrastructure.

headline: Seamec wins Rs 19.02 Cr charter hire order from G R Infraprojects
summary: Seamec secures Rs 19.02 crore work order for vessel charter hire for ONGC projects. Order book coverage remains low at 0.08 quarters, but revenue growth is robust.

headline: Blue Cloud launches BluEdge sovereign AI software
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions launched BluEdge, a sovereign AI inference engine for AccessGenie 5.0, enabling on-premise deployment across diverse hardware.

headline: India probes IPA imports from EU, South Korea, Taiwan, US
summary: The Indian government has initiated an investigation into imports of isopropyl alcohol from the European Union, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United States.

headline: Tata Motors denies knowledge of any negotiations
summary: Tata Motors has denied knowledge of any negotiations, while shares of Tata Chemicals and TMPV dropped up to 3% after a proposal reduced Tata Sons' listing hopes.

headline: Govt plans ₹2 trillion boost for exporter tax refund schemes
summary: The government plans to increase funding for two major tax refund programmes for exporters to ₹2 trillion over five years, covering textiles, capital goods, jewelry, and machinery.

headline: DGTR recommends five-year anti-dumping duty on HFC blends
summary: India's Directorate General of Trade Remedies has recommended a five-year anti-dumping duty on hydrofluorocarbon blends imported from China.

headline: BofA maintains Buy on Mahanagar Gas, target ₹1,330
summary: BofA reiterates Buy rating on Mahanagar Gas with a target price of ₹1,330, citing favourable risk-reward, policy tailwinds, and volume growth guidance of 8-9% p.a.

headline: India-Qatar step up investment treaty and FTA talks
summary: India and Qatar are accelerating talks on a bilateral investment treaty and free trade agreement, with a $10 billion Qatar investment commitment reported to be in focus.

headline: India smartphone prices rise 16% in H1 2026
summary: India smartphone prices rose 16% in H1 2026, driven by surging memory costs, with the budget segment bearing the heaviest impact, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Apple India iPhone exports hit $13.2 billion
summary: Apple's India iPhone exports rose 47% to a record $13.2 billion between April and August. The company also launched Apple Pay in India.

headline: SC seeks 16% uniform retail markup cap on medicines
summary: The Supreme Court has sought a uniform 16% retail markup cap on medicines, flagging a wide gap between maximum retail price and price to retailer, as reported by a newspaper.

headline: Avalon Technologies shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 40,49,122 Avalon Technologies shares on BSE, valued at ₹883.05 crore, at a price of ₹2,180.85 per share.

headline: Innova Captab shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,800,000 Innova Captab shares changing hands on BSE at ₹1080.00, with combined value of ₹194.40 crore.

headline: R R Securities approves FY26 financials, auditor reappointment
summary: R R Securities Limited held its 33rd AGM on September 29, 2026, approving FY26 audited financial statements and the reappointment of statutory auditors for four years.
